notes.title: Maintenance and Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
Changes:

 VSYNC and Buffering options are now available in the FPS settings on the home screen
 VSYNC or triple buffering can help those who experience screen tearing from monitor refresh rate related issues. 
However, please be advised that using VSYNC on multiple simultaneous applications can cause screen freezing or white-screen crashes. As a general tip, If you are alt-tabbing between different applications, consider turning vsync OFF.
 Optimized some more Shaders for dynamic lighting
 Xbox controllers are now automatically detected when plugged in, and the correct default configuration is applied. For other controllers, you may need to activate steam input separately as we are still in the process of optimizing partial controller support.

 Quest “Restore Crew Haven” now retroactively finishes for all other players on multiplayer if any player on a server clears the rubbles.
 Fixed an issue where Maple syrup taps were not interactable via mouse clicks if placed close to other syrup taps.
 Maple Syrup tap now properly shows the time remaining on collecting Maple Syrup.
 Clam and Crab harvester ranges have been increased. Your crew will now harvest clams and crabs without needing the presence of the captain as long as job orders are given.
 Windmill, Iron Stove, Advanced Fermenters, and Advanced Aging Barrels have had their ranges increased
 Fixed an animation issue with the shovel where the sound and effects were not timed properly
 Pickup animation now only plays once every second to avoid glitching when someone spams the F key to pick up something nearby.
 Fixed an issue where the sprint ability was taking too much energy at a higher energy pool (when more points were added to the energy stat).
 Added some smoothing when player character turns instead of flipping instantly towards the direction of motion
 Fixed a bug where Chairs were taking damage during the storms
 The stats panel background in the inventory window is changed to display the stats a bit more clearly.
 The Quest Journey Home Part 1 is now available at the Shady Trader
 The Quest Obtain a Treasure Map is now given when someone breaks the lost chest at the Crash site  for the first time.
 The in- game journal has been updated to include a new Trading tab with more information to come on Trading and Trade deliveries.

notes.title: Performance and Maintenance Patch
notes.notes:
World Save notification is now shown when the world is about to save.
 A 10 second heads up notification is now shown when world save is about to happen.
 Optimized the world system for better performance.


You will likely see noticeable smoothness overall as a result of this patch!
You will now see increased framerates while sailing in the ocean.
Players with large bases will also see a smoother gameplay overall.

Side Effects:
As a result of this patch, you might see some items take a little time (a few seconds) to appear and/or destroy. For example, Lights, small decorations, cups, plates, etc. We reduced their overhead costs to save on performance. It should not be an issue that impacts gameplay at all. 

Thanks to everyone who contributed their save files to help optimize the world better for base builders and combat enthusiasts alike!

Please remember to leave us reviews! Every little bit helps!
We are a very small team of 2, working on a project that is larger than life. We are committed to making this game all it can be!

Build Creative Tiki Bases 

Unleash your creativity and take your Tiki / Bamboo builds to a whole new level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/955b3d4f26e0231032388b3316a857395e74bc3c.png

 Hip Roofs can also be attached to bamboo large trim (pillar) and  bamboo doorways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/e3ff7ed1b146fea889bcfd628e62165e73cad6c2.jpg  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/8a366da6a68754dd12f6b5da48298abf73858de6.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/82bde0baf8d94ba8a0406107d9ae92ed1ed225a8.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/487eb7c01435c4a9757ae3324612c4a34f0fcc8e.jpg   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/1c91feec8e93d1b8e7e3b81411b725a70102c959.png


 Hip Roofs can also be attached to other Hip Roofs and Valley Roofs expanding the number of possible variations of the roof line.
 Valley Roof can attach to Gable Roof pieces such as bamboo Right Roof, bamboo Middle Roof, and Left Roof - Note that right and left bamboo roofs are determined by the direction of the angled frayed edges when placing a roof on wall (when facing the wall from the inside).
 Bamboo Windows can now be placed on both sides of the Bamboo Window Wall.
 Bamboo Foundation and Half Foundations can now be attached to the bottom of the foundation stairs creating a potential to build various landings on your staircases.

Major Performance Optimization
Forgotten Seas is a CPU intensive, multiplayer base building game. We will continue to optimize at every chance we get. We are a 2 person  team and this is a monumental task. It will take some time. We thank you for your patience. 

We have optimized several aspects of the game to bring you faster frame rates and smoother gameplay. Some of you may see triple digit framerates in newly created worlds and an overall smoother performance. Currently saved worlds will also benefit from performance optimizations, depending on how many storage entities, and building pieces are placed close to each other.

Overall, there should still be a noticeable boost in your performance, whether your world is new or old. While we have increased the number of building units that can be rendered effectively in a small area, you may experience some bottlenecks in heavily congested areas with a lot of building and processing units. To continue to experience a smoother performance as your world grows, try spreading out your buildings, processing units and other decorations.

Significantly Faster World Load Times

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/627e1881b026f3521ceb52d1d7f4811430a435d4.png

We have optimized world loading to bring you significantly faster world loading times regardless of your base build size. Most worlds should load within 15-30 seconds as opposed to 2-5 min loading times before for larger worlds! Don’t let loading times hold you back any more. Get ready to Unleash your creativity!

Other Changes

 Added a no-build zone near the tropical and forest traders to prevent players inadvertently building too close to the trader location. This is to prevent the trader ship from intruding in your homes!
 Fixed some translation related issues. We are aware that there may be some missing or incorrect translations. We will be making more of these fixes over a period of time. 
 Added new loading scene images for world loading, teleporting and respawning.
 Fixed an issue that was causing incompatibility related UI crashes when using a mouse with extremely high poll rates. This manifested to some users as the UI icons being stuck on the screen or non responsive while dragging the mouse.

notes.title: Crafting Update - Craft from nearby chests!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/aa61dde1c6100afd37c899c6353e5dd1c995a96b.png
Extended Inventory for Crafting
You can now craft items using ingredients stored in nearby storage chests when using a workbench or the player crafting menu (C keybind). 

This feature only affects workbenches and player crafting menu, but not the tiered processing units such as drying racks, campfires, smokers, etc. Tiered processing units will continue to function (as they were previously) from their own respective storages.

During the crafting process, the crafting system will first check for ingredients in the player inventory, then the storage chests. If ingredients are stored in different chests, the crafting system will progressively check for ingredients in each nearby chest and take what is needed, prioritizing the player’s inventory first.

Note that if similar crafting ingredients are spread out in multiple chests, it will take from a random nearby chest 

For players who prefer a classic crafting system, "crafting from nearby chest" feature can be turned on and off using the F9 key (Experimental and Subject to change)

Shared Multiplayer Crafting from Storage 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/b9567572178506f31a4809fa2e07f466a92c2c42.png
Client and server share nearby storages for crafting. In multiplayer mode, a client can craft from the server’s storage chests and vice versa.

Other Changes

Removed Winter Event items including Snow Forts, red satchels, and gift box visuals from Common Treasure Cache. Christmas Trees and Presents currently rezzed will still be seen, but the Building Hammer can no longer place them in the world.
 Some visual optimizations to fog and lighting has been done.

notes.title: Alpha Update - Ship Fittings & Ghost Ships!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/44d81f9149cfffe117839904315cabc0bdb0f369.png

Ghost Ship Encounter
Ghost ships can be found roaming in lightning storms or tempests near maelstroms. Defeating them can provide items of great benefits. Ghost ships deal extensive 'Bio Damage' so bring the right ship that can handle storms well and is resistant to Bio Damage type.

Introducing Ship Fittings
Fit your ship with Bulkhead Upgrades of various tier levels. Each ship in the game has special Tier benefits. For example, interceptor class ships (such as Naval Cutter) are resistant to Bio Damage
Cruiser class ships (such as Soul Queen) are resistant to Frost Damage and so forth. Check the blueprints of your ship for more details.

Installing a bulkhead in your ship will boost its tier level and make the ship even more resistant to its specialized damage type. For instance, installing a bulkhead in a Naval Cutter will make it more resilient to lightning storm damage and ghost ships. Making it an ideal ship to take to these encounters.

Other Changes:

 Fixed some leaky roofs in player buildings to avoid rain from leaking inside!

notes.title: Demo Update: QOL changes and FPS Camera optimization
notes.notes:
Usability Improvements and Support for different playstyles

Thank you so much for your patience and feedback as we addressed some issues with the FPS camera mode. The FPS camera mode was mostly experimental when the demo was first released. We have made some stability and usability changes to this mode.  We understand that everyone has different preferences when it comes to camera movement. Our eyes are peeled on feedback, and it is our utmost priority to make sure we accommodate as many playstyles as possible. With this in mind, we have made some improvements!

Interaction Changes:

 It is now easier to interact with objects using left click and double click while in the fps camera mode. You can interact with objects such as campfires, drying racks, etc. by simply double-clicking on them while in the fps camera mode. We still support E to interact on items in fps mode, however, point and click is the preferred and stable playstyle.


Attack Changes:

 You can now left click to attack monster character targets when your mouse aim is on the monster characters. Left click attack system will only work when your aim on the monster characters is accurate. Clicking outside the hit box will yield no results.


We still support auto attack on double clicks and free attack mode such as "V". 
These modes are helpful when you prefer the fixed camera playstyle. 
Feel free to pick the playstyle you enjoy!

New Quests!
Two new Raft quests have been added to the message in a bottle.

QOL Changes:

 You spoke, we heard! You can now hop on the turtles to ride them!
(We were surprised by just how many requests we received for the above!)
 Chopping stump now makes firewood quicker. Also added visual aids to the chopping stump.
 Reduced leather requirement for the raft.
 Water now gives slightly more thirst instantly.
 The copper sword can now be crafted at an earlier level.
 An additional fish pool now spawns.
 You can now find more driftwood logs on the shores.
 Tooltips of certain items have been updated to provide more hints.
 Campfire, Drying Rack, and Chicken now drop items properly when full.
 Steamed Clam and Steamed Crab can now be cooked in the basic campfire.
 Target bars now properly reset on death.
